references.text: Israel shall be a holy people and a kingdom of priests, reflecting the promise to be a holy people for the Lord
Israel is chosen as a holy people for the Lord, set apart from all other peoples on earth
The Lord will exalt Israel above all the nations of the earth if they obey his commands
Israel's greatness among the nations due to God's nearness and righteous laws
The Lord will make Israel a praise and glory among all the peoples of the earth
Believers are a chosen people, a holy people called to proclaim his greatness
Israel shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy people
